# Input Data

## Packages

::: callout-note
I used the `changepoint` package to test for a change in mean in the data set. The `cpt.mean()` package tested this using the AMOC method, which was suitable for data with a single change point.
:::
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
if(require("changepoint")){
    print("changepoint is loaded correctly")
} else {
    print("trying to install changepoint")
    install.packages("changepoint")
    if(require(changepoint)){
        print("changepoint installed and loaded")
    } else {
        stop("could not install changepoint")
    }
}
library(here)
```

```{r}
all_data_clean <- read_csv(here("data", "lineup_clean.csv")) |>

         )


```


# Change Point Analysis

::: callout-note
Only analyzed target plots.
:::

```{r}
#| warning: false

cploc_CPD <- function(x){
  cpt.mean(x, method="AMOC",class=FALSE)->cploc # <1>
  cploc |> as.numeric()
}

mean_diff <- function(x){
  cpt.mean(x, method="AMOC",class=TRUE)->cploc 
  param.est(cploc)$mean |> diff() |> as.numeric()
}
cp_test_results <- df |> 
  filter(panel=="target") |>
  group_by(picid) |> 
  summarize(change_point = cploc_CPD(value)[1],
            confvalue = cploc_CPD(value)[2] |> round(4)#,
            # shift_size = mean_diff(value) |> round(1)
) |> 
  mutate(CP_detected = case_when(change_point==30 | confvalue <0.90~"No", # <2>
                                 .default="Yes")) |> # <2> 
ungroup()

cp_test_results |> left_join(pic_details,by="picid") |>  #<3>
  # relocate(shift_size,.before= theta) |> 
  mutate(visual_changepoint = round(30*cpLoc,2)) |> 
  relocate(visual_changepoint,.before=change_point) -> cp_test_results

cp_test_results |>  
DT::datatable()
```


1. Outputs a vector with length 2: estimated change point location and "confidence value". 

2. If the change point is set at 30, this means there was no detected change point. If the confidence value < 0.90 when the change point is less than 30, this means the algorithm is not too sure that we have a change point.

3. Joining the target plot distribution details with the change point results.

:::callout-warning
Confidence value is not the same as the confidence level in a confidence level interval. It's basically telling us if the algorithm is sure that there is indeed a change point there.
:::


## Confidence Value Plots

```{r}
confvalue_plt <- cp_test_results |> 
filter(theta!=0) |> # <1>
mutate(Location=case_when(visual_changepoint == 10~"Early",
                visual_changepoint == 15~"Middle",
                visual_changepoint == 20~"Late"),
          MagDir = case_when(theta ==-5 ~"- High", theta ==5 ~"+ High", theta==3~ "+ Medium", theta==-3~ "- Medium", theta == 1~" + Low", theta == - 1~" - Low"),
          Variance = case_when(sigma==1~"Low",sigma==2~"High"))  |> 
mutate(MagDir = factor(MagDir, levels=c("- High","- Medium"," - Low"," + Low","+ Medium","+ High")),
Variance = factor(Variance,levels=c("Low","High")),
Location = factor(Location,levels=c("Early","Middle","Late"))) |> 
dplyr::select(confvalue,CP_detected,Location,MagDir,Variance,version)

confvalue_plt |> 
dplyr::select(-CP_detected) |> 
group_by(MagDir, Variance,Location) |> 
summarize(avg_confvalue = mean(confvalue)) |> 
ungroup() |> 
ggplot(aes(y=MagDir,x=avg_confvalue)) + 
facet_grid(Location~ Variance,labeller=label_both) + 
geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
theme_bw() +
labs(y = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       x = "Confidence Value",
       title = "Change Point Analysis (changepoint::cpt.mean()) confidence values"
       ) 

```

::: callout-note
This looks similar to the identification probability plots.
:::


```{r}

all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
   mutate(Location = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            ),
          MagDir = case_when(theta ==-5 ~"- High", theta ==5 ~"+ High", theta==3~ "+ Medium", theta==-3~ "- Medium", theta == 1~" + Low", theta == - 1~" - Low"),
          Variance = case_when(sigma==1~"Low",sigma==2~"High"))  |> 
mutate(MagDir = factor(MagDir, levels=c("- High","- Medium"," - Low"," + Low","+ Medium","+ High")),
Variance = factor(Variance,levels=c("Low","High")),
Location = factor(Location,levels=c("Early","Middle","Late"))) |> 
  group_by(Location, Variance, MagDir) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n())|> 
  ggplot(aes(y = MagDir, 
             x = prop_correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#1F87B4") +
  facet_grid(Location ~ Variance, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       x = "",
       title = "Proportion of Participants who correctly identified the target panel"
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14)
        )
```

## Change Point with Visual Inference

```{r}
prop_correct_df <- all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
   mutate(Location = fct_recode(cpLoc,
                            "Early" = "0.333333333",
                            "Middle" = "0.5",
                            "Late" = "0.666666667"
                            ),
          MagDir = case_when(theta ==-5 ~"- High", theta ==5 ~"+ High", theta==3~ "+ Medium", theta==-3~ "- Medium", theta == 1~" + Low", theta == - 1~" - Low"),
          Variance = case_when(sigma==1~"Low",sigma==2~"High")) |> 
mutate(MagDir = factor(MagDir, levels=c("- High","- Medium"," - Low"," + Low","+ Medium","+ High")),
Variance = factor(Variance,levels=c("Low","High")),
Location = factor(Location,levels=c("Early","Middle","Late"))) |> 
  group_by(version, Location, Variance, MagDir) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n())


confvalue_plt |>
left_join(prop_correct_df,by=c("MagDir","Variance","Location","version")) ->comp

comp |> 
ggplot(aes(x=confvalue,y=prop_correct)) + 
# geom_text(aes(label=MagDir))+
geom_point(aes(shape=MagDir),size=3) +
#geom_label(aes(label=Location),nudge_x=0.1)+
geom_hline(yintercept=0.5) + 
geom_vline(xintercept=0.5) + 
facet_grid(Location~Variance,labeller=label_both)+
theme_bw() +
scale_shape_manual(name="Direction/Magnitude",
                    values=c(0,1,2,17,16,15))+
labs(x = "Change Point Analysis Confidence",
       y = "Identification Probability",
       title = ""
       ) 
ggsave("changepoint_cplocXvariance.png",dpi=300, width=10, height=10, units="in")

comp |> 
ggplot(aes(x=confvalue,y=prop_correct)) + 
# geom_text(aes(label=MagDir))+
geom_point(aes(shape=MagDir),size=3) +
#geom_label(aes(label=Location),nudge_x=0.1)+
geom_hline(yintercept=0.5) + 
geom_vline(xintercept=0.5) +

theme_bw() +
scale_shape_manual(name="Direction/Magnitude",values=c(0,1,2,17,16,15))+
labs(x = "Change Point Analysis Confidence",
```
